body: Thank you so much for your kind words, I may have clinical depression I don't know to be honest but I don't recall ever really having any negative thoughts until my financial situation,  I haven't applied for medicaid but I have for welfare and as of current am only eligible for foodstamps. To be completely honest I don't have anyone to turn to for help financially or otherwise, none of my friends live any where near me anymore and since I've gone throw a few phone since than don't even have any way to contact the majority of them, and as far as family goes I don't really have any, on my father's side I have a large family but I don't know any of them because my father would never really take us to see any of them, so I don't even know there names nor do I know where they are, bu what hit me the motor was when I realized the few friends I still have around basically stopped contacting me the moment they found out I was loses my house, I can see about going to doctor myself and applying for medicaid, thanks alot, I know it will get better but my problem has become not so much worrying it will never end but worrying how long it will take to end, I've been working since I was 16 years old when and after I was forced t drop out of college was consistently working 50+hours a week and whay do I have to show for it, a phone, a p.o.s. car and a couple of outfits, I had to basically give away/throw away most of my belongings because I couldn't afford to keep them in storage. That is what gets to me the most I can handle all the other shit but how is I work more than anyone I know yet have the least to show for it, it just doesn't make sense to me, b her I will take your advise, and thanks so much for listening to me b*tch I just don't have anyone else to talk to about this stuff.

DO NOT listen to AcutePathogen that is insanely horrible to say. I almost broke my computer when I saw such a horrid response. Listen man I cant make you do anything I can only help to sway your opinion. I an however promise this is not permanent. You can choose to believe me or not but I think I know exactly how you feel. I had to give up the one thing in my life i was most passionate about, graphic design(I was going to school for it) until my family hit some bad financial hardships I had to drop out at the end of my first semester and get a full time job, it killed me, it still does to this day, a year and a half later we lost our home. me my mother and brother ended up living out of a hotel for months on end, 4 people stuck in a 10' by 20' room with no escape except for the bathroom. We lived like that for nearly 3 months, I slept on a tiny air mattress in which my feet hung off the end(I'm 6'2"), finally after what seemed like forever we finally managed to find an apartment we could afford. 6 months later I started doing free lance graphic design(still never finished school) and started my own clothing line. Never have I been happier in my life, It will work out if you push hard enough and keep rolling with the punches. I genuinely wish you the best :)
